title: Sema Ragalai
desc: In order to go abroad in search of his dream job, Satya agrees to kidnap his friend's lover. However, he abducts the wrong woman and is stuck with her.

title: Kadhal Devathai
desc: Raju, a caretaker of four orphaned children, is elated when he finds a magical ring in the Himalayas. On the other hand, Indraja, the daughter of Lord Indra, lands on Earth to retrieve her lost ring.

title: Neethaane En Ponvasantham
desc: Varun and Nithya's childhood romance is cut short when they pursue different paths in life. Years later, fate reunites them and Varun sets out on a heartfelt journey to win back the love of his life.
